'''Opero 77''' is a 3★ [[Polearm]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A weapon equipped by Endfield operators to significantly boost their combat capabilities.|One of the standard-issue operator weapons manufactured by Endfield Industries. This weapon is personally designed by senior Endfield Arsenal Engineer Opero. It can be wielded effectively by even newly minted Endfield operators, thanks to its ergonomic designs.}}
